definitions.rationale: Base equation for the declarative scanGroups fold: consuming an empty suffix returns the accumulated output sequence.
Recursive scanGroups equation defining that a space is ignored while the current group, depth, and accumulator are preserved.
definitions.text:
rule scanGroups(iCons(32, REST:IntSeq), CUR:IntSeq,
                  DEPTH:Int, ACC:ValSeq)
    => scanGroups(REST, CUR, DEPTH, ACC)

definitions.rationale: Recursive scanGroups equation for an opening parenthesis, defining current-group extension and depth increment.
definitions.text:
rule scanGroups(iCons(40, REST:IntSeq), CUR:IntSeq,
                  DEPTH:Int, ACC:ValSeq)
    => scanGroups(REST,
                  seqConcat(CUR, iCons(40, .IntSeq)),
                  DEPTH +Int 1,
                  ACC)

definitions.rationale: Owise structural dispatch equation completing scanGroups by delegating its remaining character case to the scanClose helper.
definitions.text:
rule scanGroups(iCons(C:Int, REST:IntSeq), CUR:IntSeq,
                  DEPTH:Int, ACC:ValSeq)
    => scanClose(C, REST, CUR, DEPTH, ACC)
    [owise]

definitions.rationale: Conditional scanClose equation defining the group-completion case: reset current/depth and append the completed group when closing reaches depth zero.
definitions.text:
rule scanClose(C:Int, REST:IntSeq, CUR:IntSeq,
                 DEPTH:Int, ACC:ValSeq)
    => scanGroups(
         REST,
         .IntSeq,
         0,
         valSeqConcat(
           ACC,
           vCons(str(seqConcat(CUR, iCons(C, .IntSeq))), .ValSeq)))
    requires DEPTH -Int 1 ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: Complementary scanClose recurrence defining a nested close that extends the current group and decrements depth without emitting a group.
definitions.text:
rule scanClose(C:Int, REST:IntSeq, CUR:IntSeq,
                 DEPTH:Int, ACC:ValSeq)
    => scanGroups(REST,
                  seqConcat(CUR, iCons(C, .IntSeq)),
                  DEPTH -Int 1,
                  ACC)
    requires DEPTH -Int 1 =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining balancedTail on an empty suffix as exactly the zero-final-depth condition.
Recursive balancedTail equation defining spaces as depth-neutral and ignored by the contract predicate.
definitions.text:
rule balancedTail(iCons(32, REST:IntSeq), DEPTH:Int)
    => balancedTail(REST, DEPTH)

definitions.rationale: Recursive balancedTail equation defining an opening parenthesis as increasing the tracked depth.
definitions.text:
rule balancedTail(iCons(40, REST:IntSeq), DEPTH:Int)
    => balancedTail(REST, DEPTH +Int 1)

definitions.rationale: Recursive balancedTail equation defining the remaining character case as a closing parenthesis with a positive-depth guard and depth decrement.
definitions.text:
rule balancedTail(iCons(C:Int, REST:IntSeq), DEPTH:Int)
    => C ==Int 41 andBool DEPTH >Int 0
       andBool balancedTail(REST, DEPTH -Int 1)
    requires C =/=Int 32 andBool C =/=Int 40

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the empty code sequence to satisfy the parenthesis-or-space alphabet predicate.
Recursive parenSpaceOnly equation defining the accepted character codes and recurring over the remaining sequence.
definitions.text:
rule parenSpaceOnly(iCons(C:Int, REST:IntSeq))
    => (C ==Int 32 orBool C ==Int 40 orBool C ==Int 41)
       andBool parenSpaceOnly(REST)

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named solutionClosure proof term as the exact translated function closure; it introduces no execution fact.
definitions.text:
rule solutionClosure
    => closureVal(
         ("paren_string", .ParamNames),
         Assign(Name("groups"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
         Assign(Name("current"), Str(""))
         Assign(Name("depth"), Int(0))
         For(Name("character"), Name("paren_string"),
           If(Compare(Name("character"), CmpOp("==", Str(" "))),
             Continue .Stmts,
             .Stmts)
           AugAssign(Name("current"), "+", Name("character"))
           If(Compare(Name("character"), CmpOp("==", Str("("))),
             AugAssign(Name("depth"), "+", Int(1)) .Stmts,
             AugAssign(Name("depth"), "-", Int(1)) .Stmts)
           If(Compare(Name("depth"), CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
             Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("groups"), "append"),
                       (Name("current"), .Exprs)))
             Assign(Name("current"), Str(""))
             .Stmts,
             .Stmts)
           .Stmts)
         Return(Name("groups"))
         .Stmts,
         0)
